Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the ATP page and conflated Jorge Lozano’s doubles peak (No. 4) with his singles peak. The ATP page shown by WebSurfer clearly listed a singles Career High Rank of 51 (1988-09-12), consistent with earlier search results. By incorrectly stating Lozano’s singles career high as No. 4, the Planner concluded the wrong winner.
